title: Calder Quinn Distressed Canvas Trucker Hat
description: The official Calder Quinn signature washed trucker cap. Features heavyweight cotton front panels in weathered tobacco brown, breathable vintage mesh, and Calder's Appalachian ridge crest embroidered on the front. Pre-curved brim with authentic distressed edge detailing.

title: Leave the Light in the Hollow Vintage Heavyweight Tee
description: Official debut release tee. 100% garment-dyed ring-spun cotton in washed coal charcoal. Pre-shrunk, heavyweight 6.1 oz feel with distressed hand-lettered album artwork and Appalachian pine horizon screenprint.

title: Calder Quinn Campfire Chore Fleece Hoodie
description: Heavyweight 400gsm fleece hoodie in weathered dark olive. Built for cold mountain mornings and late tailgate sessions. Double-stitched seams, thick ribbed cuffs, antique brass eyelets, and Calder Quinn heartland emblem on left chest.

title: Talk to Headlights Speckled Campfire Mug
description: 16 oz speckled steel enamel campfire mug in rustic warm cream with dark forest green rim. Lightweight, durable, and shatterproof. Laser-engraved with Calder Quinn Appalachian crest on one side and 'Talk to Headlights on the Wall' lyric on reverse.
